standard_prerequisites.name: Weakly etale morphisms are stable under fibre products and equalizers
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: More on Morphisms, the section on weakly etale morphisms, in particular their stability under base change and the corresponding closure properties
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the fact that fibre products and equalizers of weakly etale morphisms over S are again weakly etale over S, which gives the fibre products and equalizers in the small pro-etale site.

core_obligations: Fibre products (proof lines 2604-2620): the big pro-etale site contains Spec(Z) and is closed under products and fibre products by construction; for U -> S, V -> U and W -> U in the site, the fibre product V x_U W is the fibre product in the category of schemes over S, hence also a fibre product in the site over S, and if U, V, W are weakly etale (respectively affine) over S then V x_U W is weakly etale over S (respectively affine), which gives the fibre products in the small and in the affine pro-etale sites.

Equalizers in the big site (proof lines 2622-2628): the equalizer of two maps a, b : U -> V in the category of schemes is exhibited as an explicit fibre product of U x U with V over the diagonal of V, so it belongs to the big pro-etale site by the closure properties; the same description over S gives equalizers in the site of schemes over S.

Equalizers in the small site and final objects (proof lines 2628-2634): if U and V are weakly etale over S then the explicit equalizer is a fibre product of schemes weakly etale over S and hence weakly etale over S, which gives equalizers in the small pro-etale site; the assertions about final objects are immediate since S/S and Spec(Z) lie in the respective categories.
proof_roadmap: Verify that the fibre products of schemes lie in each of the four categories, using closure under products and the stability of weak etaleness and affineness.
Write the equalizer of two parallel maps as an explicit fibre product and check membership in each category.
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies that the big pro-etale site, the site of schemes over S, the small pro-etale site of S and the site of affine schemes over S have fibre products agreeing with those of schemes, that the first three have equalizers agreeing with those of schemes, and identifies the final objects (statement lines 2549-2564). The proof (proof lines 2566-2604) checks the closure properties for fibre products, exhibits the equalizer as an explicit fibre product over a diagonal, and verifies stability under weak etaleness and affineness. H2: several verifications with two inputs, written out in full.
